summary: Refined the aswang crawler walk motion with grounded weight shifts, squared sine arc lifts, torso lean, and phase-lagged arm/head responses.
expectedEffect: Improved readability and silhouette weight distribution during locomotion without altering root authority or clip timing.

 local floating=form=="SHROUD" or form=="FLOATING_HEAD" or form=="OBJECT_SWARM" or form=="RIBBON" or form=="LANTERN"
 pose("Torso",0,floating and math.sin(time*2.4)*.13 or .03*breathe,0,0,moving and wave*.025 or breathe*.015,0)
